verses: Taa Seen Meem
Yeh aayaten roshan kitab ki hain
Unn kay eman na laney per shayad aap to apni jaan den gay
Agar hum chahatay to unn per aasman say koi aisi nishani utartay kay jiss kay samney unn ki gardaney khum ho jatin
Aur unn kay pass rehman ki taraf say jo bhi naee naseehat aaee yeh uss say roo-gardani kerney walay bann gaye
Unn logon ney jhutlaya hai abb unn kay pass jaldi say uss ki khabren aajayen gi jiss kay sath woh maskhara pann ker rahey hain
Kiya unhon ney zamin per nazren nahi dalen? Kay hum ney uss mein her tarah kay nafees joray kiss qadar ugaye hain?
Bey shak uss mein yaqeenan nishani hai aur unn mein kay aksar log momin nahi hain
Aur tera rab yaqeenan o hi ghalib aur meharban hai
Aur jab aap kay rab ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko awaz di kay to zalim qom kay pass jaa
Qom Firaun kay pass, kiya woh perhezgari na keren gay
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha meray perwerdigar! mujhay to khof hai kay kahen woh mujhay jhutla (na) den
Aur mera seena tang ho raha hai meri zaban chal nahi rahi pus to Haroon ki taraf bhi wahee bhej
Aur unn ka mujh per meray aik qusoor ka (dawa) bhi hai mujhay darr hai kay kahen woh mujhay maar na dalen
Janab bari ney farmaya! hergiz aisa na hoga, tum dono humari nishaniyan ley ker jao hum khud sunnay walay tumharay sath hain
Tum dono Firaun kay pass ker kaho kay bila-shuba hum rab aalameen kay bhejay huye hain
Kay to humaray sath bani israeel ko rawana kerdey
Firaun ney kaha kay kiya hum ney tujhay teray bachpan kay zamaney mein apney haan nahi pala tha? Aur tu ney apni umar kay boht say saal hum mein nahi guzaray?
Phir to apna woh kaam ker gaya jo ker gaya aur to na-shukron mein hai
(hazrat) Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney jawab diya kay mein ney uss kaam ko uss waqt kiya tha jabkay mein raah bhoolay huye logon mein say tha
Phir tum say khof kha ker mein tum mein say bhaag gaya, phir mujhay meray rab ney hukum o ilm ata farmaya aur mujhay apney payghumbaron mein say ker diya
Mujh per tera kiya yehi woh ehsan hai? Jissay to jata raha hai jabkay tu ney bani israeel ko ghulam bana rakha hai
Firaun ney kaha rab aalameen kiya (cheez) hai?
(hazrat) Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney farmaya woh aasmano aur zamin aur unn kay darmiyan ki tamam cheezon ka rab hai, agar tum yaqeen rakhney walay ho
Firaun ney apney ird-gird walon say kaha kay kiya tum sunn nahi rahey?
(hazrat) Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney farmaya woh tumhara aur tumharay aglay baap dadon ka perwerdigar hai
Firaun ney kaha (logo!) tumhara yeh rasool jo tumhari taraf bheja gaya hai yeh to yaqeenan deewana hai
Hazrat Musa alaihi as-salam ney farmaya! o hi mashriq maghrib ka aur unn kay darmiyan ki tamam cheezon ka rab hai, agar tum aqal rakhtay ho
Firaun kehney laga sunn ley! agar tu ney meray siwa kissi aur ko mabood banaya to mein tujhay qaidiyon mein daal doon ga
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha agarcheh mein teray pass koi khulli cheez ley aaon?
Firaun ney kaha agar to sachon mein say hai to ussay paish ker
Aap ney (ussi waqt) apni laathi daal di jo achanak khullam khulla (zabardast) azdaha bann gaee
Aur apna hath khench nikala to woh bhi ussi waqt her dekhney walay ko safaid chamkeela nazar aaney laga
Firaun apney aas pass kay sardaron say kehney laga bhaee yeh to koi bara dana jadoogar hai
Yeh to chahata hai kay apney jadoo kay zor say tumhen tumhari sir zamin say hi nikal dey, batao abb tum kiya hukum detay ho
Unn sab ney kaha aap ussay aur uss kay bhai ko mohlat dijiye aur tamam shehron mein harkaaray bhej dijiye
Jo aap kay pass zee ilm jadoo jadoogaron ko ley aayen
Phir aik muqarrar din kay waday per tamam jadoogar jama kiye gaye
Aur aam logon say bhi keh diya gaya kay tum bhi majmay mein hazir hojao gay?
Takay agar jadoogar ghalib aajayen to hum unn hi ki pairwee keren
Jadoogar aaker Firaun say kehney lagay kay agar hum jeet gaye to humen kuch inam bhi milay ga?
Firaun ney kaha haan! (bari khushi say) balkay)yeh aisi soorat mein tum meray khaas darbari bann jao gay
(hazrat) Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney jadoogaron say farmaya jo kuch tumhen daalna hai daal do
Unhon ney apni rasiyan aur laathiyan daal den aur kehney lagay izzat Firaun ki qasam! hum yaqeenan ghalib hi rahen gay
Abb (hazrat) Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney bhi apni laathi maidan mein daal di jiss ney ussi waqt unn kay jhoot moot kay kartab ko nigalna shuroo kerdiya
Yeh dekhtay hi dekhtay jadoogar bey ikhtiyar sajday mein gir gaye
Unhon ney saaf keh diya kay hum to Allah rab aalameen per eman laye
Yani Musa (alaihi as-salam) aur Haroon kay rab per

Firaun ney kaha kay meri ijazat say pehlay tum uss per eman ley aaye? Yaqeenan yehi tumhara woh bara (sardar) hai jiss ney tum sab ko jadoo sikhaya hai, so tumhen abhi abhi maloom hojaye ga, qasam hai mein abhi tumharay hath paon ultay tor per kaat doon ga aur tum sab ko sooli per latka doon ga
Unhon ney kaha koi haraj nahi, hum to apney rab ki taraf lotney walay hain hi
Uss bana per kay hum sab say pehlay walay banay hain humen umeed parti hai kay humara rab humari sab khatayen moaf farma dey ga
Aur hum ney Musa ko wahee ki kay raaton raat meray bandon ko nikal ley chal tum sab peecha kiye jao gay
Firaun ney shehron mein harkaaron ko bhej diya
Kay yaqeenan yeh giroh boht hi kum tadaad mein hai
Aur uss per yeh humen sakht ghazab naak ker rahey hain
Aur yaqeenan hum bari jamat hain unn say chokanna rehney walay
Bil-aakhir hum enhen baghaat say aur chashmon say
Aur khazanon say. Aur achay achay muqamaat say nikal bahir kiya
Ussi tarah hua aur hum unn (tamam) cheezon ka waris bani israeel ko bana diya
Pus fiaroni sooraj nikaltay hi unn kay taaqqub mein niklay
Pus jab dono ney aik doosray ko dekh liya, to Musa kay sathiyon ney kaha, hum to yaqeenan pakar liye gaye
Musa ney kaha, hergiz nahi. Yaqeen mano, mera rab meray sath hai jo zaroor mujhay raah dikhaye ga
Hum ney Musa ki taraf wahee bheji kay darya per apni laathi maar, pus ussi waqt darya phat gaya aur her aik hissa pani ka misil baray pahar kay hogaya
Aur hum ney ussi jagah doosron ko nazdeek laa khara ker diya
Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko aur uss kay tamam sathiyon ko nijat dey di
Phir aur sab doosron ko dobo diya
Yaqeenan uss mein bari ibrat hai aur unn mein aksar log eman walay nahi
Aur be-shak aap ka rab bara hi ghalib aur meharban hai?
Unhen Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ka waqiah bhi suna
Jabkay unhon ney apney baap aur apni qom say farmaya kay tum kiss ki ibadat kertay ho?
Unhon ney jawab diya kay ibadat kertay hain buton ki, hum to barabar unn kay mujawar banay bethay hain
Aap ney farmaya kay jab tum unhen pukartay ho to kiya woh suntay bhi hain?
Ya tumhen nafa nuksan bhi phoncha saktay hain
Unhon ney kaha yeh (hum kuch nahi jantay) hum to apney baap dadon ko ussi tarah kertay paya
Aap ney farmaya kuch khabar bhi hai jinhen tum pooj rahey ho
Tum aur tumharay aglay baap dada, woh sab meray dushman hain
Ba-juz sachay Allah Taalaa kay jo tamam jahaan ka palanhaar hai
Jiss ney mujhay peda kiya hai aur o hi meri rehbari farmata hai
O hi hai jo mujhay khilata pilata hai
Aur jab mein beemar parr jaon to mujhay shifa ata farmata hai
Aur o hi mujhay maar dalay ga phir zindah kerdey ga
Aur jiss say umeed bandhi hui hai kay woh roz jaza mein meray gunahon ko bakhsh dey ga
Aey meray rab! mujhay qooat faisla ata farma aur mujhay nek logon mein mila dey
Aur mera zikar khair pichlay logon mein bhi baqi rakh
Mujhay nematon wali jannat kay warison mein say bana
Aur meray baap ko bakhsh dey yaqeenan woh gumrahon mein say tha
Aur jiss din kay log doobara jalaye jayen mujhay ruswa na ker
Jiss din kay maal aur aulad kuch kaam na aaye gi
Lekin faeedah wala o hi hoga jo Allah Taalaa kay samney bey aib dil ley ker jaye
Aur perhezgaron kay liye jannat bilkul nazdeek laa di jaye gi
Aur gumrah logon kay liye jahannum zahir kerdi jaye gi
Aur unn say poocha jaye ga kay jin ki tum pooja kertay rahey woh kahan hain?
Jo Allah Taalaa kay siwa thay, kiya woh tumhari madad kertay hain? Ya koi badla ley saktay hain
Pus woh sab aur kul gumrah log jahannum mein ondhay mun daal diye jayen gay
Aur Iblees kay tamam kay tamam lashkar bhi, o haan
Aapas mein lartay jhagartay huye kahen gay
Kay qasam Allah ki! yaqeenan hum to khulli ghalati per thay
Jabkay tumhen rab aalameen kay barabar samajh bethay thay
Aur humen to siwa unn badkaron kay kissi aur ney gumrah nahi kiya tha
Abb to humara koi sifarshi bhi nahi
Aur na koi (sacha) ghum khuwar dost
Agar kaash kay humen aik martaba phir jana milta to hum pakkay sachay momin bann jatay
Yeh majra yaqeenan aik zabardast nishani hai unn mein say aksar log eman laney walay nahi
Yaqeenan aap ka perwerdigar hi ghalib meharban hai
Qom Nooh ney bhi nabiyon ko jhutlaya
Jabkay unn kay bhai Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay kiya tumhen Allah ka khof nahi
Suno! mein tumhari taraf Allah ka amanatdaar rasool hun
Pus tumhen Allah say darna chahaiye aur meri baat manni chahaiye
Mein tum say uss per koi ajar nahi chahata, mera badla to sirf rab aalameen kay haan hai
Pus tum Allah ka khof rakho aur meri farmanbardari kero
Qom ney jawab diya kay hum tujh per eman layen! teri tabeydaari to razeel logon ney ki hai
Aap ney farmaya! mujhay kiya khabar kay woh pehlay kiya kertay rahey?
Unn ka hisab to meray rab kay zimmay hai agar tumhen shaoor ho to
Mein eman walon ko dhakkay denay wala nahi
Mein to saaf tor per dara denay wala hun
Unhon ney kaha kay aey Nooh! agar to baaz na aaya to yaqeenan tujhay sangsaar kerdiya jaye ga
Aap ney kaha aey meray perwerdigar! meri qom ney mujhay jhutla diya
Pus to mujh mein aur unn mein koi qataee faisla kerdey aur mujhay aur meray ba eman sathiyon ko nijat dey
Chunacha hum ney ussay aur uss kay sathiyon ko bhari hui kashti mein (sawar kera ker) nijat dey di
Baad azan baqi kay tamam logon ko hum ney dobo diya
Yaqeenan uss mein boht bari ibrat hai. Unn mein say aksar log eman laney walay thay bhi nahi
Aur be-shak aap ka perwerdigar albatta o hi hai zabardast reham kerney wala
Aadiyon ney bhi rasoolon ko jhutlaya
Jabkay unn say unn kay bhai Hood ney kaha kay kiya tum dartay nahi?
Mein tumhara amanatdaar payghumbar hun
Pus Allah say daro aur mera kaha mano
Mein uss per tum say koi ujrat talab nahi kerta, mera sawab to tamam jahaan kay perwerdigar kay pass hi hai
Kiya tum aik aik teelay per bator khel tamasha yaadgar (emaarat) bana rahey ho
Aur bari san’at walay (mazboot mehal tameer) ker rahey ho, goya kay tum hamesha yahin raho gay
Aur jab kissi per hath, daaltay ho to sakhti aur zulm say pakartay ho
Allah say daro aur meri pairwee kero
Uss say daro jiss ney unn cheezon say tumhari imdad ki jinhen tum jantay ho
Uss ney tumhari madad ki maal say aur aulad say
Baghaat say aur chashmon say
Mujhay to tumhari nisbat baray din azab ka andesha hai
Unhon ney kaha kay aap waaz kahen ya waaz kehney walon mein na hun hum per yaksan hai
Yeh to bus puraney logon ki aadat hai
Aur hum hergiz azab nahi diye jayen gay
Chunkay aadiyon ney hazrat Hood ko jhutlaya, uss liye hum ney unhen tabah kerdiya yaqeenan uss mein nishani hai aur unn mein say aksar bey eman thay
Be-shak aap ka rab o hi ghalib meharban
Samoodiyon ney bhi payghumbaron ko jhutlaya
Unn kay bhai saleh ney unn say farmaya kay kiya tum Allah say nahi dartay?
Mein tumhari taraf Allah ka amanat daar payghumbar hun
To tum Allah say daro aur mera kaha kero
Mein uss per tum say koi ujrat nahi mangta, meri ujrat to bus perwerdigar aalam per hi hai
Kiya unn cheezon mein jo yahan hain tum aman kay sath chor diye jao gay
Yani unn baghon aur unn chashmon
Aur unn kheton aur unn khujooron kay baghon mein jin kay shagoofay naram o nazuk hain
Aur tum paharon ko taraash taraash ker per takalluf makanaat bana rahey ho
Pus Allah say daro aur meri ita’at kero
Bey baak hadd say guzar janey walon ki ita’at say baaz aajao
Jo mulk mein fasad phela rahey hain aur islaah nahi kertay
Woh bolay kay bus to unn mein say hai jin per jadoo kerdiya gaya hai
To to hum jaisa hi insan hai. Agar to sachon say hai to koi moajza ley aa
Aap ney farmaya yeh hai oontni, pani peenay ki aik bari uss ki aur aik muqarrara din ki bari pani peenay ki tumhari
(khabardaar!) ussay buraee say hath na lagana werna aik baray bhari din ka azab tumhari girift ker ley ga
Phir bhi unhon ney uss ki kochen kaat dalen, bus woh pashemaan hogaye
Aur azab ney unhen aa dabocha. Be-shak uss mein ibrat hai. Aur unn mein say aksar log momin na thay
Aur be-shak aap ka rab bara zabardast aur meharban hai
Qom Loot ney bhi nabiyon ko jhutlaya
Unn say unn kay bhai Loot (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kiya tum Allah ka khof nahi rakhtay?
Mein tumhari taraf amanat daar rasool hun
Pus tum Allah Taalaa say daro aur meri ita’at kero
Mein tum say uss per koi badla nahi mangta mera ajar to sirf Allah Taalaa per hai jo tamam jahaan ka rab hai
Kiya tum jahaan walon mein say mardon kay sath shehwat rani kertay ho
Aur tumhari jin aurton ko Allah Taalaa ney tumhara jora banaya hai unn ko chor detay ho, balkay)yeh tum ho hi hadd say guzar janey walay
Unhon ney jawab diya kay aey Loot! agar to baaz na aaya to yaqeenan nikal diya jaye ga
Aap ney farmaya, mein tumharay kaam say sakht khush hun
Meray perwerdigar! mujhay aur meray gharaney ko uss (wabaal) say bacha jo yeh kertay hain
Pus hum ney ussay aur uss kay mutalaqqeen ko sab ko bacha
Ba-juz aik burhiya kay kay woh peechay reh janey walon mein hogaee
Phir hum ney baqi aur sab ko halak ker diya
Aur hum ney unn per aik khaas qasam ka meenh barsaya, pus boht hi bura meenh tha jo daraye gaye huye logon per barsa
Yeh majra bhi sirasir ibrat hai. Unn mein say bhi aksar musalman na thay
Be-shak tera perwerdigar o hi hai ghalbay wala meharbani wala
Aikah walon ney bhi rasoolon ko jhutlaya
Jabkay unn say Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay kiya tumhen darr khof nahi?
Mein tumhari taraf amanat daar rasool hun
Allah ka khof khao aur meri farmanbardari kero
Mein uss per tum say koi ujrat nahi chahata, mera ajar tamam jahano kay paalney walay kay pass hai
Naap poora bhara kero kum denay walon mein shamooliyat na kero
Aur seedhi sahih tarazoo say tola kero
Logon ko unn ki cheezen kami say na do bey baki kay sath zamin mein fasad machatay na phiro
Uss Allah ka khof rakho jiss ney khud tumhen aur agli makhlooq ko peda kiya hai
Unhon ney kaha to to unn mein say hai jin per jadoo kerdiya jata hai
Aur to to hum hi jaisa aik insan hai aur hum to tujhay jhoot bolney walon mein say hi samajhtay hain
Agar to sachay logon mein say hai to hum per aasman kay tukray gira
Kaha kay mera rab khoob jannay wala hai jo kuch tum ker rahey ho
Chunkay unhon ney ussay jhutlaya to unhen sayebaan walay din kay azab ney pakar liya. Woh baray bhari din ka azab tha
Yaqeenan uss mein bari nishani hai aur unn mein aksar musalman na thay
Aur yaqeenan tera perwerdigar albatta o hi hai ghalbay wala meharbani wala
Aur be-shak o shuba)yeh yeh (Quran) rab aalameen ka nazil farmaya hua hai
Ussay amanat daar farishta ley ker aaya hai
Aap kay dil per itra hai kay aap aagah ker denay walon mein say ho jayen
Saaf arabi zaban mein hai
Aglay nabiyon ki kitabon mein bhi uss Quran ka tazkarah hai
Kiya unhen yeh nishani kafi nahi kay haqqaniyat Quran ko to bani israeel kay ulamaa bhi jantay hain
Aur agar hum ussay kissi ajami shakhs per nazil farmatay
Pus woh unn kay samney uss ki tilawat kerta to yeh ussay bawar kerney walay na hotay
Ussi tarah hum ney gunehgaron kay dilon mein uss inkar ko dakhil ker diya hai
Woh jab tak dard-naak azabon ko mulahiza na kerlen eman na layen gay
Pus woh azab unn ko gahan aajaye ga unhen uss ka shaoor bhi na ho ga
Uss waqt kahen gay kay kiya humen kuch mohlat di jaye gi?
Pus kiya yeh humaray azab ki jaldi macha rahey hain?
Acha yeh bhi batao kay agar hum ney unhen kaee saal bhi faeedah uthaney diya
Phir unhen woh azab aa laga jin say yeh dhamkaye jatay thay
To jo kuch bhi yeh barattay rahey uss mein say kuch bhi faeedah na phoncha sakay ga
Hum ney kissi basti ko halak nahi kiya hai magar ussi haal mein kay uss kay liye daraney walay thay
Naseehat kay tor per aur hum zulm kerney walay nahi hain
Uss Quran ko shetan nahi laye
Na woh uss kay qabil hain, na unhen uss ki taqat hai
Balkay)yeh woh to sunnay say bhi mehroom ker gaye hain
Pus to Allah kay sath kissi aur mabood ko na pukar kay to bhi saza paney walon mein say hojaye
Apney qareebi rishtay walon ko dara dey
Uss kay sath farotni say paish aa, jo bhi eman laney wala ho ker teri tabeydaari keray
Agar yeh log teri na-farmani keren to to ailaan kerdey kay mein unn kaamon say beyzaar hun jo tum ker rahey ho
Apna poora bharosa ghalib meharban Allah per rakh
Jo tujhay dekhta rehta hai jabkay to khara hota hai
Aur sajdah kerney walon kay darmiyan tera ghoomna phirna bhi
Woh bara hi sunnay wala aur khoob hi jannay wala hai
Kiya mein tumhen bataon kay shetan kiss per utartay hain
Woh her aik jhootay gunehgar per utartay hain
(uchat’ti) hui suni sunaee phoncha detay hain aur unn mein say aksar jhootay hain
Shaeeron ki pairwee woh kertay hain jo behkay huye hun
Kiya aap ney nahi dekha kay shaeer aik aik bayabaan mein sir takratay phirtay hain
Aur woh kehtay hain jo kertay nahi

Siwaye unn kay jo eman laye aur nek amal kiye aur ba-kasrat Allah Taalaa ka zikar kiya aur apni mazloomi kay baad intiqam liya, jinhon ney zulm kiya hai woh bhi abhi jaan len gay kay kiss kerwat ulat’tay hain
